feed.title: Delegated underwriting reshapes global insurance markets, Moody’s finds
feed.summary: Moody’s Ratings reports that delegated underwriting, through entities like MGAs and Lloyd's coverholders, is rapidly growing in global insurance markets due to rising demand for complex risks and insurers' need for specialist expertise. While this approach helps insurers access niche segments and diversify, Moody’s cautions that it can erode profit margins, weaken underwriting control, and shift economic value towards intermediaries, especially with increased private equity investment in the MGA sector. Strong oversight will be crucial as insurers increase their reliance on third-party underwriting partners.
